title: List It, Get Paid, Move On (Full Frame)
whatItIs: The full-frame version of the steps slide: a ticket logo, a 6/7 counter, a blue tag, a three-line black headline and seven pale rounded rows with blue left rules, and a faint 05/07 page mark.
whatItMeans: The clean grid of same-height rows makes each step equally weighted, and there is nothing else on the slide to distract.
techniques: Faint page counter in the corner

vocabulary.definition: A list where every item has the same visual size.
A faint numbering in the corner of a slide.
An image showing the whole slide without device chrome.
